responsibility: Declares the printing API for GCC wide_int values, including decimal and hexadecimal formatting to buffers or FILE streams and the standard print buffer size constant. It is the public companion to wide-int-print.cc for code that needs to emit arbitrary-precision integers in human-readable form without depending on dump-specific helpers.
same_name_distinction: Declares the public formatting API and buffer-size constant for wide_int printing, with implementations in wide-int-print.cc. It differs from wide-int.h by covering only output/rendering support, not the wide-int arithmetic framework itself.
